title: Evidence
description: A piece of evidence as a first-class record with its own lifecycle and its own clock. 'valid' is the document's validity in the world; 'obtained_at' and history timestamps are when WE came to believe something about it.

locator.description: Where inside the document. A wrong locator is a fidelity failure: correct the record, do not change status.

status.description: Only 'authentic' warrants a claim. Everything else withdraws warrant — which sends dependent claims to unknown, never to contradicted.

valid.description: The document's own validity in the world. null 'to' means open-ended.

derives_from.description: Evidence id this one is downstream of. Two records sharing an ancestor are NOT independent witnesses.

history.description: Append-only. Evidence is never deleted on a status change.

basis.description: Evidence about the evidence — why we changed our mind.
